points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 卢梭出生于日内瓦一个钟表匠家庭，母亲在他出生时去世。他的童年充满了对阅读的热爱和对自然亲近的体验。尽管家境贫寒，但接受了良好的基础教育，学习了拉丁语、古典文学和音乐。这段时期形成了他对自由、平等和共和制的早期政治理念，以及他对自然状态的浪漫想象。日内瓦的共和传统深深影响了他的政治思想，使他后来成为日内瓦公民身份的坚定捍卫者。
points.descriptionEn: Rousseau was born in Geneva to a watchmaker family, with his mother dying at his birth. Despite their modest circumstances, he received a good education, learning Latin, classical literature, and music. This period fostered his early political ideas about freedom, equality, and republicanism, as well as his romantic imagination of the state of nature. Geneva's republican tradition profoundly influenced his political thought, making him a staunch defender of Geneva's citizenship later in life.

points.title: 艺术探索
points.description: 离开日内瓦后，卢梭前往巴黎，开始了长达十余年的艺术生涯。他学习音乐理论，发明了一种新的记谱法，并结识了狄德罗等启蒙思想家。这段时期他经历了多次职业转变，从家庭教师、音乐教师到秘书，生活颠沛流离。在巴黎，卢梭逐渐形成了自己独特的思想体系，开始写作关于音乐和政治的文章。1740年，他担任里昂税务官员的秘书，这一经历使他深刻了解了社会不平等，为他后来的社会批判奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving Geneva, Rousseau moved to Paris, embarking on a decade-long artistic career. He studied music theory, invented a new system of musical notation, and met Enlightenment thinkers like Diderot. During this period, he experienced multiple career changes, from tutor to music teacher to secretary. In Paris, Rousseau gradually developed his unique philosophical system, beginning to write about music and politics. In 1740, he served as secretary to the tax collector in Lyon, an experience that gave him deep insight into social inequality, laying the foundation for his later social critiques.

points.title: 外交历练
points.description: 1743年，卢梭担任法国驻威尼斯大使的秘书，这段外交经历使他深入了解了政治运作和权力结构。在威尼斯，他目睹了贵族政治的腐败和外交的虚伪，这强化了他对现有政治制度的批判态度。回到巴黎后，他与沙龙文化保持距离，开始系统思考社会不平等问题。1749年，他读到第戎科学院的征文题目《科学与艺术的进步是否有助于道德改善？》，这激发了他写作《论科学与艺术》的灵感，1750年发表后一举成名，奠定了他在启蒙运动中的独特地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1743, Rousseau served as secretary to the French ambassador to Venice. This diplomatic experience gave him deep insight into political operations and power structures. In Venice, he witnessed the corruption of aristocratic politics and the hypocrisy of diplomacy, strengthening his critical attitude toward existing political systems. Back in Paris, he distanced himself from salon culture and began systematically reflecting on social inequality. In 1749, he read the question from the Dijon Academy: 'Has the progress of sciences and arts contributed to the corruption of morals?' This inspired him to write 'Discourse on the Sciences and Arts,' published in 1750, which brought him fame and established his unique position in the Enlightenment.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 1756年，卢梭移居巴黎郊外的蒙莫朗西，这是他创作最丰产的时期。在这里，他完成了《论人类不平等的起源和基础》(1755)和《社会契约论》(1762)等重要著作。这一时期，他与女友戴莱姆共同生活，远离城市喧嚣，专注于思考和写作。在蒙莫朗西，卢梭发展了他的核心政治哲学思想，包括人民主权、社会契约和公意等概念。他提出了'人生而自由，却无往不在枷锁之中'的著名论断，批判了私有制带来的社会不平等，并构想了一个基于直接民主的理想政治秩序。
points.descriptionEn: In 1756, Rousseau moved to Montmorency, a suburb of Paris, which became his most productive creative period. Here, he completed major works including 'Discourse on the Origin and Basis of Inequality Among Men' (1755) and 'The Social Contract' (1762). During this time, he lived with his companion Thérèse Levasseur, away from the city bustle, focusing on thought and writing. In Montmorency, Rousseau developed his core political philosophy, including concepts of popular sovereignty, social contract, and the general will. He proposed the famous statement 'Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains,' critiqued social inequality caused by private property, and envisioned an ideal political order based on direct democracy.

points.title: 流亡岁月
points.description: 《社会契约论》发表后，卢梭的思想引起争议，被法国政府列为禁书，他被迫逃离法国。1762-1765年间，他在瑞士的伯尔尼、莫捷等地流亡，同时受到日内瓦当局的迫害。尽管如此，这一时期他完成了《爱弥儿》和《爱洛伊丝》等重要作品。在瑞士，卢梭继续深化他的教育哲学思想，提出自然教育理念，强调儿童应按照自然规律成长。这段流亡经历加深了他对社会压迫的批判，也使他更加珍视个人自由和独立思考的价值。
points.descriptionEn: After the publication of 'The Social Contract,' Rousseau's ideas caused controversy, and the French government banned his work, forcing him to flee France. Between 1762 and 1765, he lived in exile in Bern and Môtiers in Switzerland, while also facing persecution from Geneva authorities. Despite this, he completed important works including 'Emile' and 'Julie, or the New Heloise' during this period. In Switzerland, Rousseau further developed his educational philosophy, proposing the concept of natural education that emphasized children should grow according to natural laws. This exile experience deepened his critique of social oppression and made him more value personal freedom and independent thinking.

points.title: 晚年归隐
points.description: 1765年，卢梭移居法国北部的埃默农维尔，在这里度过了生命的最后岁月。他购买了小岛上的小屋，过着简朴的隐居生活，与自然为伴。这一时期，他完成了《忏悔录》和《一个孤独的散步者的遐想》等自传性作品，坦诚地回顾了自己的一生。1778年7月2日，卢梭在散步时突然去世，享年66岁。他的墓地位于埃默农维尔的一棵橡树下，成为后人瞻仰的圣地。晚年卢梭更加关注内心世界和自然和谐，他的思想对后来的浪漫主义运动产生了深远影响，也为法国大革命提供了重要的理论资源。
points.descriptionEn: In 1765, Rousseau moved to Ermenonville in northern France, where he spent the final years of his life. He purchased a cottage on a small island, living a simple reclusive life in harmony with nature. During this period, he completed autobiographical works including 'Confessions' and 'Reveries of a Solitary Walker,' candidly reflecting on his life. On July 2, 1778, Rousseau died suddenly during a walk at the age of 66. His grave is located under an oak tree in Ermenonville, becoming a sacred place for later generations. In his later years, Rousseau focused more on his inner world and natural harmony, his thoughts profoundly influencing the later Romantic movement and providing important theoretical resources for the French Revolution.

appraisal.zh: 卢梭一般被看作民主思想与社会正义的先驱，其社会契约论为人民主权奠基，深刻影响法国大革命与美国独立战争，其教育理念与对不平等的批判至今仍有回响，被视为现代政治哲学的重要基石。另一种看法认为，他的公意概念可能通向多数暴政，为极权提供口实，对私有制的批判忽视经济发展，教育构想过于理想化；其个人生活与所倡道德标准之间的落差也常被提及。他由此成为启蒙运动内部最复杂而矛盾的思想家。
appraisal.en: Rousseau is commonly seen as a pioneer of democratic thought and social justice: his social contract laid the groundwork for popular sovereignty, deeply influenced the French Revolution and the American War of Independence, and his educational ideas and critique of inequality still resonate, making him a cornerstone of modern political philosophy. Another view holds that his general will could lead to tyranny of the majority and lend justification to totalitarianism, that his critique of private property ignored economic development, and that his educational scheme was overly idealistic; the gap between his life and the morals he preached is also noted. He remains the Enlightenment's most complex and contradictory thinker.

supporter.zh: 卢梭被支持者视为民主思想和社会正义的先驱。他的社会契约理论为人民主权奠定了基础，直接影响了法国大革命和美国独立战争。他强调个人自由与平等，批判社会不平等，提出回归自然的教育理念，这些思想至今仍具有深远影响。卢梭对现代民主制度、人权观念和公共领域的形成做出了不可磨灭的贡献，他的思想成为现代政治哲学的重要基石。
supporter.en: Rousseau is viewed by his supporters as a pioneer of democratic thought and social justice. His social contract theory laid the foundation for popular sovereignty, directly influencing the French Revolution and American War of Independence. He emphasized individual freedom and equality, critiqued social inequality, and proposed natural education concepts, ideas that continue to have profound influence. Rousseau made indelible contributions to the formation of modern democratic institutions, human rights concepts, and the public sphere, his thought becoming an important cornerstone of modern political philosophy.

critic.zh: 批评者指出卢梭思想中的矛盾和危险倾向。他的公意概念可能导致多数暴政，为极权主义提供了理论借口。他对私有制的绝对批判忽视了经济发展的重要性，其教育理念过于理想化，难以实现。此外，卢梭的个人生活与其倡导的道德标准存在明显差距，他遗弃五个孩子的事实与其强调家庭责任的主张形成鲜明对比。这些批评者认为，卢梭的思想虽然富有启发性，但缺乏实践可行性，甚至可能带来负面后果。
critic.en: Critics point out the contradictions and dangerous tendencies in Rousseau's thought. His concept of the general will could lead to tyranny of the majority, providing theoretical justification for totalitarianism. His absolute critique of private property ignored the importance of economic development, and his educational ideas were overly idealistic and difficult to implement. Furthermore, there was a clear discrepancy between Rousseau's personal life and the moral standards he advocated, as evidenced by his abandonment of five children, contrasting sharply with his emphasis on family responsibility. These critics argue that while Rousseau's ideas are inspiring, they lack practical feasibility and may even have negative consequences.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，卢梭被定义为复杂而矛盾的思想家。他既是启蒙运动的参与者，又是其批判者；既推崇理性，又强调情感和直觉的重要性。卢梭的思想跨越了多个领域，从政治哲学到教育理论，从文学到音乐，展现出惊人的创造力。他的《忏悔录》开创了现代自传文学的先河，影响了无数后来的作家。在当代，卢梭被视为现代性批判的先驱，他的思想持续引发关于自由、平等、民主和社会正义的讨论，成为理解现代政治文化不可或缺的参照点。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Rousseau is defined as a complex and contradictory thinker. He was both a participant in and critic of the Enlightenment; he valued reason while emphasizing the importance of emotion and intuition. Rousseau's thought spanned multiple fields, from political philosophy to educational theory, from literature to music, demonstrating remarkable creativity. His 'Confessions' pioneered modern autobiographical literature, influencing countless later writers. In contemporary contexts, Rousseau is seen as a precursor to modernity critique, his ideas continuing to spark discussions about freedom, equality, democracy, and social justice, becoming an indispensable reference point for understanding modern political culture.

self.zh: 人生而自由，却无往不在枷锁之中。自以为是其他一切的主人的人，反而比其他一切更是奴隶。
self.en: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains. One who believes himself to be the master of all others is nonetheless more of a slave than they are.
